yahoo.description: Yahoo Finance market data (yahoo-finance2): quotes, price history, statements, analyst estimates. Yahoo needs exchange suffixes: ASX codes end in .AX (CPU.AX), KRX in .KS (000660.KS), KOSDAQ in .KQ, NZX in .NZ, LSE in .L; US tickers have none. Convert Sharesight codes before calling. quote takes a list of symbols: one call covers many stocks (price, P/E, market cap, 52-week range). quoteSummary takes queryOptions {"modules": [...]}: financialData, defaultKeyStatistics, earningsTrend (estimates), recommendationTrend, assetProfile, calendarEvents. chart and fundamentalsTimeSeries need queryOptions.period1 (YYYY-MM-DD).

sharesight.description: Sharesight portfolios. Never ask the user for portfolio IDs or holdings: call list_portfolios first (it names every portfolio and its owner), then get_performance_report for the ones involved. A report's holdings list is exactly their current positions, with quantity, value and gains. When comparing portfolios or explaining a result, write 2-3 short paragraphs: each portfolio's return, then its tailwinds (biggest contributors, with numbers) and headwinds (biggest detractors), and what explains the gap.
